summary: The Forensic 3D flood view (PLAN-5 4.7) is built. ForensicWorkspace shows a FloodForensic branch while a flood is open (the fire Forensic is untouched): a flood without 3D data gets "Fire-3d has not prepared this flood's 3D terrain yet." with "Prepare 3D data (about 1 min)" through useFlood.startFloodBuild and its progress, and the scene loads when the job is done (checked on the real route: Calcasieu River flood prepared from the button, built in 52 s). The scene takes its assets from useSceneAssets(): IncidentAssets.manifest is typed SceneManifest (the frozen scene/fx typechecks, no cast) and scene/flood/floodAssets adds a flood part. The terrain drapes the NWS forecast flooded area (hatch), satellite water (blue with an edge; clouds, no data and snow the same grey no-view cross-hatch, never transparent or land, from a class table the shader reads), FEMA floodplain, NWS category maps and NWM model (amber dotted, labelled MODEL · EXPERIMENTAL), the last three off by default. NWS warning areas are pink lines that follow the hydrograph handle (warningsAt: the newest version at the handle; after now the products in effect now, with CURSOR_FUTURE_PRODUCTS). River gauges are bars (1 ft = 12 m) with flood-stage ticks, reading and forecast caps and mono labels, with the key line 'Bar height: river stage at the gauge (scaled), not water depth'. FloodHeader, Frame flood / Charts & NWS products, the demo badge, a scene key with each layer's own time, FloodRightPanel (Layers, Analysis, Evidence with every NWS product version verbatim, Notes; Flood overview and River gauges cards) and the dock with web-flood-command's Hydrograph (variant dock) complete it; the hand-off reads the flood's grid. Fixed copy on every state, phones included; nothing animates under reduced motion. Gates: backend 1340 passed; web typecheck, lint (55 warnings, all in src/scene), 1706 tests passed (2 skipped, not flood tests), build. Review fixes (review5-web-flood-forensic.json, 14 findings, all fixed): the 3D hover readout is scene/flood/floodProbe.ts (no negative model line, FEMA 'outside' only where FEMA's map covers the area, the satellite pass's own point sentences, the NWS product at the spot, NOTHING_COVERS; values wrap); the backend's notes on 'ok' layers and each layer's caveats are in the Layers tab and the scene key (with a fold-out 'About these layers'); FEMA's effective date (NFHL_LABEL) and every row note show in the narrow column; the key says 'NWS products in effect now…' whenever the handle is after now; the dock's absence sentence is time-bound to the saved copy; the Flood overview card reads warnings.json at build time (and its grid is fixed); the gauges card says a gauge below flood stage is not an all-clear; bar labels mirror before the right column and hide under the UI; the phone picker is the diamond plus the id; floodAssets.test.ts added; CatFIM category in words; unused copy removed; token colours in the CSS; fire regression retaken at 40 s.

known_issues: Analysis tab: no small multiples (below the cut line); it lists each gauge's reading and NWS forecast with a Chart button for the dock.

brief5-web-flood-forensic-real.png shows the Calcasieu River flood reopened after it was prepared from the button: the first Prepare screenshot run lost its state to a Vite hot reload caused by another role's concurrent edits (the store module was replaced); the build itself finished and loaded (API log), and a second run of the same flow from the store kept the flood open.
Clouds and no data can cover most of a 60 km real area (St. Johns: 66 % no data outside the Landsat swath); the grey no-view hatch then covers much of the terrain (by design, D25).
The NAIP year is not in the flood manifest: the aerial photo row says 'before this flood' without a year.
Gauge bars are 1 ft = 12 m: on a 60 km area at the default framing a bar is only ~20 px tall; the labels carry the values.

The dock's Hydrograph is web-flood-command's component (its review fixes changed the handle rows and the dock's issue time); with the products column open its title row touches the '--- FORECAST' legend in the narrower chart.
On phones most gauge bar labels are hidden by the label-placement rule (a ~40-character label runs off a 390 px screen on both sides); the dock chart and the River gauges card carry the values.
Under SwiftShader a layer checkbox switched by script just before a capture can be drawn in its old state in the PNG (fix-probe, model-on); the DOM is correct.
The fixture's NWS products were in effect at the screenshot time (the fixture was regenerated at 05:00 UTC; rerun make_fixture.py --only flood when they have ended).
cut_line_left: Analysis tab small multiples (one hydrograph per gauge)
